verdict.rationale: Letta's docs show strong architectural openness — memory blocks are stored as Markdown files, shared memory as Git repositories, and agents can run entirely on self-hosted infrastructure with local state storage requiring no cloud login — which implies data portability and freedom to leave. However, there is no explicit documented 'export my data' feature, account-deletion/migration workflow, or confirmation that all agent state (not just memory) is stored in open, portable formats. missing for 10: explicit export/migration tooling, documentation of full data portability beyond memory blocks, independent confirmation of no lock-in when leaving cloud.
